brief.audience: US adults who sort household laundry and want to keep sock pairs together.
brief.pain: matching loose socks after the wash
brief.script: Another loose sock in the laundry basket? SockLock pairs have small magnets on the cuffs that hold the pair together. Five pairs are $29, with a new delivery every quarter. See the subscription details before you order.
brief.offer: Subscription: five pairs for $29; a new delivery every quarter.

facts.text: SockLock sells socks with small magnets on their cuffs.
The magnets hold a sock pair together.
The offer is five pairs for $29, with a new delivery every quarter.
